instruction: Candid medium shot of two men walking down an outdoor stone staircase. On the left, the Black man in the gray polo shirt (R2) looks towards his partner with a warm smile. On the right, the bearded man in the black t-shirt (R1) walks beside him, looking down and smiling. They hold hands across the metal handrail between them. The background is filled with soft green foliage, illuminated by warm, natural daylight.
